violations.explanation: A GestureDetector with a decorated Container is used as a button, but no button semantics are exposed. Screen readers will announce only the text 'Continue' without identifying it as a button. Without an explicit Semantics(button: true) wrapper or a Material button widget (e.g., ElevatedButton), users may not recognize that it is actionable.

GestureDetector does not participate in focus traversal and does not respond to keyboard activation (Enter/Space). Keyboard, switch-access, and similar users cannot reach or activate the control, and no focus indicator is shown.

violations.explanation: There is no pressed, hover, or focus state feedback (no ink ripple or highlight). Users get no visual confirmation of interaction.
